name: Pools of Arlithrien
summary: South of Darnassus, the Pools of Arlithrien have grown dangerous and neglected. Their moonwell once drew night elves to a quiet sanctuary, but beasts and nearby Gnarlpine furbolgs now threaten the springs.

sections.title: A Troubled Sanctuary
sections.body: The Pools of Arlithrien lie beneath Teldrassil’s shaded boughs, south of Darnassus. A stone moonwell rests at their heart, holding waters touched by Elune’s grace. Though the sanctuary lies near the night elven capital, danger has driven the night elves to leave it untended. Agitated beasts roam the shallows, and the Gnarlpine furbolgs nearby remain hostile. What was meant to be a peaceful retreat now reflects the growing troubles across the island.

faq.q: Where are the Pools of Arlithrien located?
faq.answer: The Pools of Arlithrien lie in western Teldrassil, just south of the main bridge and entrance to Darnassus.

faq.q: Why was the moonwell here abandoned?
faq.answer: The night elves stopped tending the moonwell as danger mounted. Hostile Gnarlpine furbolgs settled nearby, while aggressive forest wildlife overran the surrounding waters.

faq.q: What threats can travelers find at the pools?
faq.answer: Aggressive woodland creatures roam the waters, and nearby territorial Gnarlpine furbolgs pose a threat to travelers.

faq.q: Can players still use the moonwell at the Pools of Arlithrien?
faq.answer: Yes. Though the priesthood and druids have left the moonwell untended because of local dangers, its sacred waters remain a functional source of lunar essence.

angles.text: For night elves, a holy moonwell left untended so close to Darnassus is a troubling sign of corruption and disruption spreading across Teldrassil.
Druids studying Teldrassil’s imbalances see the unruly wildlife and neglected moonwell as signs that the Great Tree lacks nature’s true blessing.
